turns.text: Is it worth paying extra for a chef's table?

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: It can be a bit noisy and hot, since you're right by the stoves. If she enjoys cooking, she'll probably love the action though.

turns.text: Then it sounds like a great gift. Ask whether you can chat with the chef, some are really happy to explain each course.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Plan for two and a half to three hours. Go with an empty stomach and no rush afterwards.
